channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay South Block 12 West
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay South Block 12 West (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The Block 12 West page said OCII files minutes under the month they are approved. That generalised from one example, so it now says only what was observed: the September 1, 2026 minutes are filed in the 2026-10 folder. The October 6, 2026 meeting page, checked again on October 11, 2026, still lists no minutes and no outcome, so the approval stays unconfirmed. An earlier correction on this page was also reworded to read 'This corrects the note above: the approval is not confirmed.', because the note it corrects is still shown above it.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: An earlier note here recorded the OCII Commission's approval of the Block 12 West agreement on Oct 6, 2026. It rested on a copy of the resolution marked "Adopted October 6, 2026" that was created the day before the meeting and has an unsigned certification line. The meeting's minutes are not posted, and the meeting page lists no outcome. This corrects the note above: the approval is not confirmed. The question is open on the record page.

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: OCII Commission scheduled to consider authorizing the Block 12 West MOU with FOCIL-MB (about 265 affordable and 270 market-rate units; Resolution No. 23-2026) at its October 6, 2026 meeting. The August 13, 2026 CAC deck had targeted September 2026; the item was not on the September 1 agenda and the September 15 meeting was cancelled. The outcome of the October 6 meeting is not confirmed in any source written after it (see open questions). (Oct 6, 2026)

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The record no longer calls the parcel a surface parking lot or places it at a China Basin St roundabout, because no source read says so; the 2015 property management plan lists it as 'Vacant Lot/Land'. The Aug 13, 2026 item is now a CAC presentation with Commission approval only targeted for September 2026 (not a Commission item); the claim that the Sep 15 Commission meeting was cancelled was removed (no cancellation notice was read); the 2023 item is a proposed contract with an already-selected firm (ICF) rather than a solicitation; the Farallon and 385 Channel facts now cite the 2015 plan and DBI permit M401947; the map use changed from mixed to residential (the CAC slides describe two residential projects); and two entries about permits no longer say a demolition happened or that a cost was revised on a date the permit data does not give.

item.title: Planned · Mission Bay South Block 12 West: The Successor Agency's Approved Long-Range Property Management Plan for Mission Bay lists Block 12 West (APN 8710-006, 'Northeast corner of Channel Street and Mission Bay Drive') among the Mission Bay South 'Affordable Housing Parcels' the Developer (then Catellus, now FOCIL-MB) is obligated to contribute under the 1998 Owner Participation Agreement -- establishing the parcel as a designated future affordable-housing development site years before the 2023 environmental-consultant solicitation or the 2026 subdivision MOU (Dec 2015)
